name: Quiet Sunshine (Healthy)
description: Clear line of sight, low channel contention, link operating at peak efficiency.

name: Rain Fade & Multipath
description: Signal attenuating, high retries and jitter appearing across the link.

name: RF Blackout / Link Collapse
description: Extreme packet loss (72%), heavy contention, imminent disconnection.

name: Channel Congestion
description: Good signal strength but severe channel occupancy from co-channel nodes.

name: Fringe Coverage
description: Node moved to perimeter; RSSI dropped to -88 dBm with low background noise.

name: Bufferbloat / Packet Jitter
description: Excessive transit delay variability (95ms jitter) indicating queuing congestion.

name: Borderline Transition
description: Marginal link condition near failover threshold with elevated packet loss.

name: Channel Stabilizing
description: Interference clearing, packet error rate dropping to nominal 6%.
